title: Build an LRU Cache in Rust with O(1) get and put
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement LRUCache with integer keys and values. get(key) returns -1 on miss. put(key, value) evicts the least-recently-used entry when at capacity. Use a HashMap plus a VecDeque for order tracking.

required_artifacts: LRUCache with HashMap for O(1) lookup and Vec for LRU order
get returns -1 on miss; updates recency on hit
put evicts order[0] (LRU) when at capacity before inserting
put on existing key updates value and refreshes recency
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
